query:
Two group members respond to the kiln shelf arrangement for the upcoming firing. One of them uses iron oxide wash on their stoneware and dismissed concerns about contamination; the other is the one who asked for a separate shelf because of surface sensitivity in their porcelain pieces. Which of these positions belongs to Reuben?

Options:
A. Callum
B. Reuben
C. Nadia
D. Yuki
context:
[1] (about=Callum, core, t0 @2026-01-18T10:02:00) Stoneware dust in same firing can affect porcelain surface; prefers separate shelf.
[2] (about=Callum, said_by=Nadia, profile, t6 @2026-04-12T09:43:00) Nadia offers kiln space for Callum's test tiles; confirms his shelf on top as before.
[3] (about=Callum, core, t0 @2026-01-18T10:02:00) Working on a porcelain mug set; prefers daytime slots; finds translucency of porcelain satisfying; wants separate shelf for porcelain to avoid stoneware dust contamination.
[4] (about=Nadia, core, t12 @2026-07-19T09:49:00) Has a gas firing scheduled; kiln needs loading by 2pm.
[5] (about=Nadia, core, t3 @2026-03-15T09:55:00) Seriously reconsidering firing approach after gas reduction workshop; electric kiln work feels less alive.
[6] (about=Nadia, core, t0 @2026-01-18T10:02:00) Will put Callum's porcelain shelf at top for even temperature and away from Reuben's oxide pieces.
[7] (about=Nadia, core, t3 @2026-03-15T09:55:00) Learned to stop fighting the kiln and let it do what it does; results are completely different from electric.
[8] (about=Reuben, core, t0 @2026-01-18T10:02:00) Iron oxide wash fires clean at cone 6; minimal contamination risk, but separate shelves are good practice.
[9] (about=Reuben, core, t0 @2026-01-18T10:02:00) Studio kiln runs cone 6 electric; can check glaze recipe on Sunday if Simone brings printout.

query:
In Sessions 6 and 7, Reuben credits someone's critique of his slab vessel for directing his revision work. Who gave the feedback that Reuben is acting on -- and how does the conversation make it possible to confuse this attribution with Nadia?

Options:
A. Nadia
B. Simone
C. Yuki
D. Callum
context:
[1] (about=Reuben, said_by=Yuki, profile, t8 @2026-05-17T09:38:00) Yuki gives detailed critique of Reuben's slab piece: top section resolved, lower third not, transition needed another pass; piece close but not quite working as whole.
[2] (about=Reuben, core, t10 @2026-06-14T09:55:00) Working on resolving lower third of slab vessel; acknowledges Yuki's critique was correct.
[3] (about=Reuben, core, t14 @2026-08-23T09:57:00) Spent too much time on surface at expense of form; slab vessel took four revisions because texture was attempted before structure resolved.
[4] (about=Reuben, said_by=Nadia, profile, t9 @2026-06-14T09:52:00) Nadia notes Reuben mentioned the large square vessel for open day.
[5] (about=Reuben, core, t12 @2026-07-19T09:49:00) Raising texture revision on slab vessel; has been over lower third twice; issue is switching to finer tool midway; needs to start lower section again from leather-hard stage.
[6] (about=Reuben, said_by=Simone, profile, t12 @2026-07-19T09:49:00) Simone says she respects Reuben's approach even if she would never do it herself.
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nadia, group-interaction, t0 @2026-01-18T10:02:00) Kiln load: Callum's porcelain mugs on top shelf; Reuben's oxide pieces separate; Yuki's bottles single glaze; Simone's bowls to be glazed.
[8] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nadia, group-interaction, t6 @2026-04-12T09:43:00) Nadia has been in touch with studio about member showcase at open day in June; low stakes display. Simone wants to submit teal bowl; Callum declines due to plate project; Reuben may submit one slab piece; Yuki maybe.
[9] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nadia, group-interaction, t0 @2026-01-18T10:02:00) Wheel stations vs slab table: Nadia (3 cylinders on wheel), Callum (mug set, trimming, small footprint), Yuki (narrow bottles on wheel), Reuben (slab series, no wheel), Simone (glazing bowls, no wheel).
[10] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nadia, group-interaction, t14 @2026-08-23T09:57:00) October session: Reuben prefers keeping making time intact; critique only if pieces are ready. Nadia will circulate date and keep booking regardless.
agent_answer:
The feedback Reuben is acting on came from **C. Yuki** — the memory shows Yuki gave a detailed critique of Reuben's slab piece (top resolved, lower third not, transition needs another pass), and Reuben explicitly acknowledges Yuki's critique was correct and works on resolving the lower third.

The conversation could make this easy to confuse with **Nadia** because Nadia also makes a remark about Reuben's vessel — specifically, she notes that Reuben mentioned the large square vessel for open day. Since Nadia's comment also concerns Reuben's slab/vessel work, a reader might mistakenly attribute Yuki's critique to Nadia if they conflate Nadia's observation with the actual feedback.
